Love this stuff..I have patchy bald spots in my brows that I've been filling with Benefit brow pencil. This fills in with natural looking and stays!!
Actually lives up to its description.  I really like this pen.  Works well, does Not bleed, smear or fade.  I will buy it again.
It actually last for 3 days even after I washed my face with gentle cleanser...In the future I will purchase more.

I have purchased and tried many different kinds of eyebrow products over the past 10 years.  I originally had the intention of buying the tattoo brow that you peel off but I came across this pen instead and I loved it! The color is a perfect match nice and chocolatey not “green” or too light or too redish.  It does just enough and can be more intense the harder you press.  It dries quick but not so quick you can’t fix a mistake.  It also stays a couple of days even if you use a makeup wipe.  Wil

I absolutely love this product! This was hands down the easiest brow application I've done since I started doing full face makeup! It's liquid enough that if I make an error with the blading pattern I can correct it. Once its dry you're all set, plus it lasts throughout the day so I had my brows for 16+ hours with no smearing or residue. The only thing I'd do differently is get it in black but I'm definitely buying it again!

reviews.t: it doesn't go on as advertised
reviews.x: the darkest color you can get is chestnut. my eyebrows are brown/black. the color fades quickly when applying and when you shake it, it cakes up below brush. the only thing i do like is the shape of the brush and how it does apply on the brow. you need to offer in a dark brown or soft black shade and improve how the gel/liquid adheres to the brush.

This product works okay; but I find that the wicking of the color barely sustains to allow both brows to be dealt with in a given session. It may make sense to have two on hand-using one for each brow.  Perhaps too, shaking down gently (not vigorously, as that cause the actually liquid to splatter out) would help the flow during application.

reviews.t: Color/ink gets weaker. Good customer service
reviews.x: At first it worked.  The lines were visible avd the pen allowed you to have full control if your drawn on brow precision.  The 2nd and 3rd time revealed a weaker color. It's as though the ink was fading in the tube. Wint be buying again.  Update: increased star bc the customer service is great. They issued a hassle free refund.

The Microblading Tattoo Eyebrow Pen did not work as well as expected. I'm a medium complexion African American and the pen did not show up as well in my brows, I needed a darker color. The tip doesn't really come out as strokes like the microblading effect I was hoping for. I ended up just using it to fill in my brows.

I really wanted to like this eyebrow pen but it is ridiculously dry and difficult to apply. I had to press really hard for the liquid to come out..Also it’s hard to remove if you make a mistake. Not sure how this product received so many good reviews. Maybe I got a bad pen...

Never worked, there is only a really light watery color that comes out, doesnt look good on the eyebrow. I reached out to seller who told me to give it sometime. Nothings changed it just doesnt work. I have used better products for my eyebrows in the past.

reviews.t: Not sweat or water resistant. Awful product
reviews.x: Not sweat proof or water resistant like it claims. It does go on easy and looks nice but as soon as sweat or water comes into place, it starts to run down my eye lids, absolutely awful. I wish I could return but I already opened the box..

This item looks like the more expensive brands that are advertised however it lasted exactly a week. It ran out so fast I didn't even have time to decide if I liked it or not.  Spend the extra money for the name brand.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the natural, realistic-looking results, saying it doesn't look painted on.
Many customers report the pen dries out quickly, sometimes after only one use, making it hard to keep working.
Several reviewers highlight long-lasting wear, with some saying it stays for days even after washing.
Users find it easy to use and effective for filling in thin or patchy brows.
Some customers note it is not waterproof, which was a key reason they bought it.
